research_result.description: Gumroad is a digital commerce platform enabling creators to sell products, memberships, subscriptions, and physical goods directly to consumers with built-in licensing and checkout.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can sign in to Gumroad, navigate to Advanced Settings, and either generate a personal access token directly or register an OAuth application with an application name and redirect URI to obtain an Application ID and Application Secret.

evidence.claim: Gumroad uses OAuth 2.0 for API authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Gumroad uses OAuth 2.0 for API authentication. You need to register an OAuth application to get an application ID and secret.

evidence.claim: Gumroad supports Bearer tokens passed in the Authorization header.
Gumroad provides a REST API v2 for managing products, sales, subscribers, offer codes, licenses, and webhooks.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: REST API for managing products, variants, offer codes, custom fields, sales, subscribers, license keys, resource subscriptions (webhooks), and the authenticated user account on Gumroad.

evidence.claim: Gumroad API access and developer account creation are free without usage fees.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Yes, Gumroad is completely free to use. There are no usage fees or paid tiers.

evidence.claim: Gumroad does not offer a production GraphQL API; references to GraphQL are conceptual.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: This document describes a conceptual GraphQL schema for the Gumroad digital commerce and creator economy platform.

evidence.claim: Multiple Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementations exist for Gumroad.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation for Gumroad, enabling MCP-compatible AI clients like Claude Desktop to interact with Gumroad API.
